proposed_widenings.name: suppress_spellcasting
proposed_widenings.justification: No existing atom prevents creatures from casting spells or taking Magic actions within an area. grant_extra_action / scale_attack_count are additive grants, not prohibitions. block_targeting addresses spell targeting, not the act of casting.
proposed_widenings.evidence: No one can cast spells, take Magic actions, or create other magical effects inside the aura

proposed_widenings.name: suppress_magic_item_properties
proposed_widenings.justification: No atom suppresses the active magical properties of magic items. This is distinct from block_targeting (which is about what can be targeted) and from grant_condition_immunity.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Magical properties of magic items don't work inside the aura or on anything inside it.

proposed_widenings.name: suppress_ongoing_spells
proposed_widenings.justification: end_ongoing_spells terminates spells permanently. Antimagic Field suppresses them — the spell pauses without ending, and its duration continues ticking down. On leaving the aura the spell resumes. This suppression semantic is absent from the surface.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Ongoing spells, except those cast by an Artifact or a deity, are suppressed in the area. While an effect is suppressed, it doesn't function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration.

proposed_widenings.name: block_magic_area_ingress
proposed_widenings.justification: block_targeting covers creatures/things being targeted, but no atom prevents external magical areas of effect from extending into a protected region.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Areas of effect created by spells or other magic can't extend into the aura

notes: Structural fit is strong: ongoing_effect family, area attachment with emanation shape and self-origin, concentration up to 1 hour. The existing block_travel atom could honestly cover the teleportation/planar-travel clause. The portal-closing clause is transient state with DM-adjacent flavor that may not need a dedicated atom. The blocking of magical targeting from outside may stretch into block_targeting with a broad scope string, but the anti-casting and suppression semantics have no honest home in the current surface. The suppression semantic (pause-not-end, duration continues) is the most critical gap — end_ongoing_spells would be factually wrong.
